title: Adversarial Classical Verification
description: Determine whether declared quantum-advantage claims survive progressively stronger classical attacks across a 4-level hierarchy: L0 Exact small-instance reference, L1 Tensor-network/MPS simulation, L2 Pauli-path/Clifford+T methods, and L3 Heuristic/evolutionary search under pre-registered budgets.

title: Controlled Hardware Confrontation
description: Where justified by the scientific gate, compare the frozen classical baselines against declared quantum-hardware experiments on physical QPUs (IBM Heron via BlueQubit API). Hardware execution is strictly evidence of execution, not automatically evidence of quantum advantage.

title: Scientific Adjudication
description: For every target claim, produce an explicit epistemic disposition: SUPPORTED, REFUTED, INCONCLUSIVE, or NOT_EVALUATED under adverse-first precedence. Never use VERIFIED = TRUE as a universal scientific status.

title: Reproducibility and Audit Integrity
description: Make every headline result independently reconstructable from claim, protocol, artifact digest, execution environment, raw data, analysis code, and cross-plane provenance, enabling clean-room independent reproduction.

title: Evidence-Governed AI Orchestration
description: Demonstrate that LivLM can propose and orchestrate experiments without becoming the authority that determines scientific truth: AI proposes and orchestrates; deterministic tooling measures; evidence packages preserve; adjudication decides.
